minor_findings.summary: Unicode typography was normalized in two visible strings
minor_findings.evidence: The original title uses em dashes and the yield/output text uses full-width ６, while the candidate uses en dashes and ASCII 6. The recipe meaning is unchanged.

rationale: Ingredients, setup dependencies, multilingual operation text, timing, completion criteria, and final role are semantically faithful; only nonsemantic dash and numeral glyph distinctions are lost.
